events.verdict: Smith Jr. (CHA) legally contests Alvarado's (NOP) jump shot, making "high-five" contact after the ball is released. Any ensuing body contact as Alvarado returns to the floor is marginal.
Diabate (CHA) grasps and quickly releases Missi's (NOP) arm during the rebound prior to Simpson (CHA) cleanly dislodging the ball away.
Brown (NOP) rests a hand on Jeffries' (CHA) body and the contact during his pass is marginal.
Diabate (CHA) brushes Brown's (NOP) right arm as Brown releases the pass.
Diabate (CHA) establishes a screening position in Reeves' (NOP) path and does not deliver illegal contact.
Reeves (NOP) is moving forward as Simpson (CHA) steps to the side toward his path and the ensuing contact as the two come together is marginal.
Reeves (NOP) jumps from point A to point B and initiates contact with Simpson's (CHA) lower body, affecting his shot attempt.
Smith Jr. (CHA) moves laterally into Brown (NOP) and wraps an arm around him as he gathers, affecting the driving shot attempt.
Diabate (CHA) and Brooks (NOP) briefly engage and disengage with one another as the pick is set on the perimeter.
Missi (NOP) releases his hands away from Jeffries' (CHA) side and does not apply force as he sets the pick.
Jeffries (CHA) initiates illegal contact with Alvarado's (NOP) head during the driving shot attempt.

events.category: Turnover: Out of Bounds – Bad Pass Turn
events.verdict: Simpson (CHA) is the last player to touch the ball before it goes out of bounds.
Brooks Jr. (NOP) establishes a screening position in Simpson's (CHA) path and does not deliver illegal contact during the pick. The two players then briefly engage and disengage.
Diabate (CHA) maintains a legal guarding position during Alvarado's (NOP) drive to the basket.
Jeffries (CHA) collapses his forearm and rests it against Brooks Jr. (NOP) and the contact during his shooting motion is marginal.
Missi (NOP) legally contests Salaun's (CHA) jump shot attempt.
